rule: NOAA natural survey fragments (fragment == 'Y'); not restoration outplants
evidence: Wild / naturally occurring fragments retained in the NOAA survey surface.

rule: Nursery-cultured fragments outplanted to reef habitat
evidence: Outplanted nursery-cultured fragments; size x genet and habitat x genet experiments.

rule: Tagged outplanted colonies tracked in the USGS USVI experiment
evidence: Tagged outplanted colonies; source material not described as nursery fragments in the metadata.

rule: Nursery-raised fragments outplanted after fragmentation and re-cementation
evidence: Nursery-raised fragments outplanted spring 2018; survival after fragmentation and re-cementation.

rule: Nursery fragments on PVC tables in a restoration nursery
evidence: Direct restoration nursery fragments shared by FUNDEMAR.
